records.substitution: native unit with historical instrumented copy or swapped schema
records.source_discriminator: Fixed source-owned native unit enum and exact production copy/schema template identities reject it before target.

records.substitution: normal row with optimized interpreter/job, or vice versa
records.source_discriminator: Actual sys.flags.optimize, unit/mode data and actual job optimized flag must agree.

records.substitution: copied UNKNOWN_OWNER or copied parent module passed as constructor authority
records.source_discriminator: Object identity must be the actually imported original parent and its private UNKNOWN_OWNER; parent registries and process slot must be pristine. This is within original genuine startup premises, not a sandbox against arbitrary pre-root sys.modules mutation.

records.substitution: changed code, source default, class cell, imported symbol or package edge
records.source_discriminator: Source compilation, finite default derivation, actual class-cell ownership and real namespace/package identity checks reject mismatches. Dataclass-generated methods retain original exact factory/T2 justification and later identity checks.

records.substitution: configured context or START RHS embeds own current policy/guard pin
records.source_discriminator: Empty inverse assignments and actual source-None late installation are required. Root/entry freeze precedes receiver manifest, binding plan, outer context, preparation, JOBS and final stage.

records.boundary: actual original runner tail -> Root._entry -> component_entry.main
records.substitution: arbitrary path/hash or mismatching job lane
records.source_discriminator: Parent independently validates complete original plan/source inputs and exact canonical JOBS lane. Driver requires fixed Root tail. The original genuine command/input provenance remains required, not minted by JSON.
Original pending flag remains true and original owner is quarantined; no target dispatch follows. Pending is not physical retirement.

records.substitution: local body error while an unrelated older exception is active, plus failures from both known closes
records.source_discriminator: Explicit local primary preserves first delivered operation error; preallocated raw close slots and unrolled attempts preserve both close errors and consumed descriptor identities without appending between closes. No ambient sys.exc_info classification and no uncertain-close retry.

records.substitution: second entry or installation attempt, stale module map or changed mode/context
records.source_discriminator: Attempt registration precedes acquisition; phase/consumed state and actual same-process module/source/context relationships reject reuse.

records.substitution: same-prefix log, changed inode, absent stderr, or a pending supervisor observation
records.source_discriminator: Independent pre-ACK reader must join exact actual final path, complete bytes/hash/identity, EOF and stability. Full actual stderr must be empty and retained.
